# HYDRA-EO roadmap: campaigns, modelling, validation, and transfer

HYDRA-EO is moving from its start-up and first campaign phase into the
development of harmonised datasets, RTM-informed trait retrieval, and
multi-site validation. This page connects project phases with concrete
scientific and dissemination milestones.
:::

::: {.timeline-now}
<span>Current position</span>

**Late summer 2026** · Multi-country campaigns and RTM-Suite release completed or under way; dataset harmonisation and hybrid RTM-ML development are active.
:::

## Project phases

::: {.timeline-roadmap aria-label="HYDRA-EO project phases from 2026 to 2028"}
::: {.timeline-year .timeline-year-active}
### 2026 · Observe & establish

::: {.timeline-phase-status}
Active
:::

- Scientific requirements and trait-stressor framework
- Field, UAV, airborne, and satellite campaigns
- RTM-Suite consolidation and public documentation
- First simulation libraries and inversion workflows
- Scientific dissemination and partner coordination
:::

::: {.timeline-year}
### 2027 · Develop & validate

::: {.timeline-phase-status .timeline-status-planned}
Next phase
:::

- Harmonised multi-country experimental datasets
- RTM sensitivity and sensor intercomparison
- Hybrid trait retrieval and disease-stress discrimination
- Cross-date, cross-crop, and cross-site validation
- UAV-to-satellite scaling and uncertainty assessment
:::

::: {.timeline-year}
### 2028 · Integrate & transfer

::: {.timeline-phase-status .timeline-status-planned}
Planned
:::

- Integrated HYDRA-EO processing framework
- Operational demonstrations and stakeholder-oriented outputs
- Scientific roadmap for FLEX, CHIME, LSTM, and related EO missions
- Training, open tools, publications, and final dissemination
:::
:::

## Milestones in 2026

::: {.timeline-events}
::: {.timeline-event .timeline-complete}
::: {.timeline-event-date}
January-June 2026
:::

### Project foundations

Scientific requirements, use cases, crop-stressor priorities, consortium
coordination, campaign design, and initial integration of modelling and Earth
Observation workflows.

::: {.timeline-event-tag}
Completed
:::
:::

::: {.timeline-event .timeline-complete}
::: {.timeline-event-date}
May-July 2026
:::

### Five Lelystad potato UAV campaigns

WU-DES conducted campaigns on 11 May, 16 June, 25 June, 1 July, and 21 July,
combining VNIR hyperspectral, thermal, fluorescence/SIF, RGB, disease, and plant
measurements. The final campaign supported comparison with the 19 July EnMAP
acquisition.

[Explore the campaign story](news/hydra-eo-campaigns-2026.qmd){.timeline-event-link}

::: {.timeline-event-tag}
Completed
:::
:::

::: {.timeline-event .timeline-complete}
::: {.timeline-event-date}
June-August 2026
:::

### First airborne campaign cycle

Campaigns at El Chaparrillo, Valencia, and the Bologna region expanded the
project across potato, olive, pistachio, and vineyard systems, including
collaboration with CERBERUS, CIAG-IRIAF, IAS-CSIC, and regional plant-health
partners.

::: {.timeline-event-tag}
Completed
:::
:::

::: {.timeline-event .timeline-complete}
::: {.timeline-event-date}
9-14 August 2026
:::

### Two contributions presented at IGARSS 2026

HYDRA-EO research on forest productivity and early fungal detection was
presented in Washington, D.C. The conference papers are available from the
project News page.

[View the conference outputs](news.qmd#ieee-igarss-2026){.timeline-event-link}

::: {.timeline-event-tag}
Completed
:::
:::

::: {.timeline-event .timeline-complete}
::: {.timeline-event-date}
27 August 2026
:::

### RTM-Suite public release

The R and Python ecosystem now connects leaf, canopy, soil, atmosphere,
energy-balance, fluorescence, sensor convolution, and plant-trait inversion
with 31 reproducible tutorials and interactive applications.

[Explore RTM-Suite tools](tools.qmd){.timeline-event-link}

::: {.timeline-event-tag}
Released
:::
:::

::: {.timeline-event .timeline-active}
::: {.timeline-event-date}
31 August-5 September 2026
:::

### Late-summer campaign at El Chaparrillo

Planned repeat airborne and field acquisitions over olive and pistachio systems,
combining VNIR-SWIR hyperspectral and thermal observations with physiological,
biochemical, and disease reference measurements.

::: {.timeline-event-tag}
Upcoming
:::
:::

::: {.timeline-event .timeline-active}
::: {.timeline-event-date}
1 September 2026
:::

### Repeat vineyard observations in Italy

Follow-up campaign targeting vineyards affected by *Flavescence dorée* in
collaboration with CERBERUS and Italian research partners.

::: {.timeline-event-tag}
Upcoming
:::
:::

::: {.timeline-event .timeline-active}
::: {.timeline-event-date}
15-17 September 2026
:::

### ICOS Science Conference 2026

José Luis Pancorbo will present accepted contributions on PROSAIL-based
estimation of carbon constituents in alfalfa and the integration of PRISMA,
Sentinel-2, and ICOS flux towers for ecosystem productivity monitoring.

[View conference details](news.qmd#icos-science-conference-2026){.timeline-event-link}

::: {.timeline-event-tag}
Upcoming
:::
:::
:::

## Work-package status

The ten work packages operate as a connected programme rather than a strictly
sequential list. Their current emphasis is summarised below.

::: {.timeline-wp-groups}
::: {.timeline-wp-group}
::: {.timeline-wp-heading}
**Foundations & coordination** <span>Active throughout</span>
:::

- **WP1** - Scientific requirement consolidation
- **WP10** - Project management, reporting, risk, and contractual coordination
:::

::: {.timeline-wp-group .timeline-wp-current}
::: {.timeline-wp-heading}
**Observations & experimental data** <span>Primary 2026 focus</span>
:::

- **WP2** - Field, UAV, airborne, satellite, and in-situ dataset collection
- **WP4** - Experimental EO products, synthetic data, and stress-specific libraries
:::

::: {.timeline-wp-group .timeline-wp-current}
::: {.timeline-wp-heading}
**Models & scientific exploitation** <span>2026-2027</span>
:::

- **WP3** - RTM, sensitivity, sensor comparison, inversion, and validation
- **WP5** - Trait analysis, stress dynamics, and UAV-to-satellite scaling
:::

::: {.timeline-wp-group}
::: {.timeline-wp-heading}
**Impact, collaboration & roadmap** <span>Growing toward 2028</span>
:::

- **WP6** - Agricultural relevance and stakeholder transfer
- **WP7** - Scientific roadmap and recommendations for future missions
- **WP8** - Collaboration with ESA, European projects, and research networks
- **WP9** - Publications, conferences, training, open tools, and outreach
:::
:::
